scope: Bounded Node VM fixtures execute actual web source and extracted actual placement functions. Java bridge guards are source-inspected only. No emulator, browser, native UI, gameplay or device persistence verified.

checks.name: One native apply request survives repeated timer polls while pending and becomes ready only after durable acknowledgement
Rewards opens a read-only native view only after Build exit completes
Native rejection and persistence failure keep the startup gate closed
Ending a match before an apply acknowledgement prevents persistence and use of its late result
Stale saved configuration and acknowledgements from another session fail closed
Dormant Duel receives no rewards module, timer, bridge call or reward progress callback
Actual native wave progress is forwarded before terminal settlement and duplicated output settles once
Unrelated mode packets do not establish a Towers battle or report reward progress
Actual fortress line policy forbids purchased lines and preserves normal researched and ordinary defence lines
Legacy paid fortress taps use native queue reservation instead of Ctrl-click; ordinary paths stay intact
